spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(o.order_date, $__interval),
  c.country AS metric,
  GREATEST(0, LEAST(100, ROUND(
    GREATEST(0, 100 - (SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'payment_timeout' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 300)) * 0.40
    + (SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100 * 0.35)
    + LEAST(100, AVG(o.total_amount) / 5) * 0.15
    + ((1 - SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) * 100 * 0.10)
  , 1))) AS value
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.order_date)
AND c.country IS NOT NULL
AND c.country != 'Not Set - Default'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  o.order_id,
  c.country,
  o.device,
  o.total_amount,
  o.status
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'payment_timeout'
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC
LIMIT 20
